body:
Could be simplified a bit with f-strings maybe (excluding the first one as it's a bit of a complex expression to embed in the string IMO).
```suggestion
        str(env["ANDROID_NDK_ROOT"])
        + f"/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/{host_subpath}/sysroot/usr/lib/{triple_target_dir}/libc++_shared.so"
```

Or if we want to include everything on a long line, this should work:
```python
stl_lib_path = f"{env['ANDROID_NDK_ROOT']}/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/{host_subpath}/sysroot/usr/lib/{triple_target_dir}/libc++_shared.so"
```
